correctness.rationale: The stationary convolution is bounded and rotationally invariant. The Markov-generator identities have positive determinants and exactly reconstruct all moments through degree four; verify.py proves the rational kurtosis identity by symbolic cancellation. Positive denominators and positive constant term reduce classification to discriminant, root sum/product and leading-term signs; fixed-g large-d coefficient asymptotics prove two separated positive roots. Exact rational sample signs and an event-driven numerical experiment support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The quarter-rate critical boundary is a dimensionless competition between physical chirality switching and trap relaxation; its independence from rotational diffusion in the high-angular-speed limit is structurally unexpected. The theorem gives a global necessary-and-sufficient sign diagram, uniqueness for fast switching, and two different asymptotic root scales for physically motivated reentrant behavior with slow switching. These are not mere parameter substitutions or small numeric improvements.
